environment.description: Same Ktor 2.3.4 service deployed on ECS Fargate. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance configured with a restricted database role. The connection pool authenticates as 'app_ro_svc' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-iam-auth' with pg_hba.conf entry type 'hostssl' and role attributes defined as NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE. The role has schema-level default privileges revoked (ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES REVOKE ALL ON TABLES FROM app_ro_svc) and only explicit grants applied per migration: the current grant set is SELECT on tables users, accounts, transfer_log in schema public. No USAGE grant on sequences. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=ddl' and pgaudit.log='write' but these are observability controls only. An ALB with HTTP/2 enabled sits in front with idle timeout 60s.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with HTTP/2, idle_timeout=60s, no WAF attached
config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON users, accounts, transfer_log TO app_ro_svc; -- no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
